group.name: Which Skyrim Together do you use?

plugin.name: Nexus 1.8.3 (official)
plugin.description:
The official Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.3 from its Nexus page: the main file (Skyrim 1.7.104) or the optional file "for 1.6.1170" (Skyrim 1.6.1170/1.6.1179). Pick this if you are not sure.
Plays on any official 1.8.3 server. Everyone in your session must use the same Skyrim Together version.

plugin.name: 1.8.5 (absol89 / our 1.5.97 port)
plugin.description:
Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.5: absol89's release for 1.7.104 or 1.6.1170/1.6.1179, or the 1.5.97 port built on it.
Plays on 1.8.5 servers only; 1.8.3 and 1.8.5 cannot join each other's servers.

group.name: Which Skyrim do you play on? (Skyrim Together 1.8.3)

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.7.104
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special/Anniversary Edition 1.7.104 with the Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.3 main file from Nexus (SKSE 2.3.x).
Installs the Skyrim Together launcher with the LipSync Together add-on (SkyrimTogetherReborn/SkyrimTogether.exe). Mod Organizer 2 users: after installing, copy it into your Skyrim Together Reborn mod's SkyrimTogetherReborn folder (back up the original first); see the README.

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.6.1170 / 1.6.1179
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special/Anniversary Edition 1.6.1170 or 1.6.1179 with the Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.3 optional file "for 1.6.1170" from Nexus (SKSE 2.2.6).
Installs the Skyrim Together launcher with the LipSync Together add-on (SkyrimTogetherReborn/SkyrimTogether.exe). Mod Organizer 2 users: after installing, copy it into your Skyrim Together Reborn mod's SkyrimTogetherReborn folder (back up the original first); see the README.

plugin.name: Skyrim 1.5.97
plugin.description:
Skyrim Special Edition 1.5.97 (SKSE 2.0.20) with Skyrim Together Reborn 1.8.5.
Installs the 1.5.97 Skyrim Together launcher with the LipSync Together add-on: SkyrimTogetherReborn/SkyrimTogether.exe, EarlyLoad.dll, TPProcess.exe and versionlib-ae-to-se-1-5-97-0.map. Skyrim Together has no 1.5.97 launcher of its own, so this one comes with the mod; you do not need any other 1.5.97 port. Plays on 1.8.5 servers only. Mod Organizer 2 users: after installing, copy these four files into your Skyrim Together Reborn mod's SkyrimTogetherReborn folder (back up the originals first); see the README.
